how_to_apply: Visit the official BDCC Bank website, www.belagavidccb.bank.in, and click on "BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026."
Read the notification and instructions carefully, accept the terms and conditions, and click "Open Application" to proceed.
Click "Apply" against the relevant post and fill in the application form. Verify all entered details carefully, then click "Preview."

On the Preview page, use "Edit" to correct any details if needed, upload a passport-size photograph, and click "Next." (A Registration ID and Password will be sent to your registered email for future edits — keep these safe.)

Upload your scanned photograph and signature. The photograph must be under 100 KB (approx. 3.5cm x 4.5cm) with a plain background, and the signature under 50 KB (approx. 3.5cm x 2.0cm). Once submitted, the photo/signature cannot be changed.
Upload self-attested scanned copies of all relevant certificates — educational qualification, caste/category proof, computer knowledge proof, etc.
Click "Pay Online" to pay the prescribed application fee along with the applicable bank gateway charges through the e-payment gateway.

Click "Print Application" after previewing, and download a copy of your submitted application. Keep this printout for future reference — the file size of the printed application copy must be less than 100 KB when uploading it wherever required.

content_sections.heading: BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. Applicants must be able to read, write, and speak Kannada. Applicants can apply for only one post; if a candidate applies for more than one post, only the first submitted application is considered valid. Candidates already in service must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their current employer.

content_sections.heading: BDCC Bank Second Division Clerk Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Applicants must hold a Bachelor's degree (BA/B.Sc/B.Com) from a university legally established and recognized in India. Basic knowledge of computer operation and applications is required for this post; if a candidate has completed at least one computer-related course, the certificate for it may be submitted voluntarily.

content_sections.heading: BDCC Bank Gun Man Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Applicants must have passed SSLC/10th standard or an equivalent examination, and should either be retired armed-forces personnel with weapons training or an ex-serviceman, and must hold a valid Arm License.

content_sections.heading: BDCC Bank Peon Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Applicants must have passed SSLC/10th standard or an equivalent examination.

content_sections.heading: BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age is reckoned as on the fee-payment closing date, 27.08.2026.

content_sections.heading: BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee must be paid only online, through the payment gateway on the application portal. Demand Draft, Cheque, Postal Order, or Money Order are not accepted under any circumstances. Fee once paid is non-refundable, and cannot be adjusted against any other recruitment. Candidates applying for more than one post (under separate notification serial numbers) must pay a separate fee for each post. Fee payment corrections or changes are not entertained after the closing date of 27.08.2026.

content_sections.heading: BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a Written Examination followed by an Interview, conducted as per the method prescribed by the Karnataka State Cooperative Societies Registrar's office. A merit list is prepared based on written exam marks. Candidates are shortlisted for interview in a 1:5 ratio against each post. The interview carries a maximum of 15 marks. The final merit list is prepared by combining written exam marks and interview marks, and candidates are selected as per the applicable reservation policy. Details of the exam admission letter, date, and exam schedule will be announced on the bank's website.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Selected/shortlisted candidates must produce the following original documents at the time of verification: Marks card / transcript / provisional degree certificate / convocation certificate for the qualifying education SSLC (or equivalent) certificate showing date of birth, or an Extract of Cumulative Record, or a government-issued birth certificate / School Leaving (Transfer) Certificate Caste/category certificate for candidates claiming reservation benefits Non-creamy layer certificate, where applicable Computer knowledge proof certificate — required only for Second Division Clerk applicants, not for Peon or Gun Man posts No Objection Certificate from the current employer, for candidates already in service

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official BDCC Bank website, www.belagavidccb.bank.in, and click on "BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026." Read the notification and instructions carefully, accept the terms and conditions, and click "Open Application" to proceed. Click "Apply" against the relevant post and fill in the application form. Verify all entered details carefully, then click "Preview." On the Preview page, use "Edit" to correct any details if needed, upload a passport-size photograph, and click "Next." (A Registration ID and Password will be sent to your registered email for future edits — keep these safe.) Upload your scanned photograph and signature. The photograph must be under 100 KB (approx. 3.5cm x 4.5cm) with a plain background, and the signature under 50 KB (approx. 3.5cm x 2.0cm). Once submitted, the photo/signature cannot be changed. Upload self-attested scanned copies of all relevant certificates — educational qualification, caste/category proof, computer knowledge proof, etc. Click "Pay Online" to pay the prescribed application fee along with the applicable bank gateway charges through the e-payment gateway. Click "Print Application" after previewing, and download a copy of your submitted application. Keep this printout for future reference — the file size of the printed application copy must be less than 100 KB when uploading it wherever required.

content_sections.heading: BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for only one post; if applications are submitted for more than one post, only the first submitted application is treated as valid. Applications submitted through an agent, agency, or courier will not be accepted. Applications with incomplete or unclear information, or submitted without the prescribed fee, will be rejected. Requests for reconsideration, complaints, or queries related to this recruitment sent by letter, email, or phone will not be entertained. The bank reserves the right to cancel or withdraw this recruitment notification at any stage. Candidates' own travel expenses for the written exam and interview must be borne by themselves. The bank's Recruitment Committee's decision on any matter relating to eligibility, acceptance, or rejection of applications is final.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: As per the notification, the following categories of persons are not eligible to apply: Persons who are not citizens of India. Persons disqualified under the Representation of the People Act, 1972, for corrupt election practices. Persons convicted of a criminal offence by a court of law. Persons dismissed from bank service. Persons dismissed or removed from Central/State Government service, or from a public sector or cooperative institution, for corruption or misconduct. Persons convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude and not since rehabilitated. Persons who, having a living spouse, married another person (or vice versa). Members of an unlawful body or organization, or persons in contact with such bodies. Persons who do not respect the Constitution of India, or have acted against India's sovereignty and integrity, state security, public order, or friendly relations with foreign states, or have insulted the national flag, anthem, or emblem. Persons debarred by any competent authority from government or cooperative institution recruitment or examinations for adopting unfair means such as impersonation or cheating. Persons who are medically unfit for the post. Persons currently in service whose employer does not release them / provide a No Objection Certificate. Those based in Karnataka can check the latest Karnataka Government Jobs for more opportunities in the state. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 104 vacancies in total — 83 Second Division Clerk posts, 1 Gun Man post, and 20 Peon posts.

faq.question: Q2. When can I apply online for BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online applications can be submitted from 27 July 2026 to 27 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500 (plus bank gateway charges) for SC, ST, and Category-1 candidates, and Rs. 1000 (plus bank gateway charges) for all other categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for BDCC Bank Second Division Clerk post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree (BA/B.Sc/B.Com) from a university legally established and recognized in India, along with basic knowledge of computer operation and applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for BDCC Bank Peon and Gun Man posts?
faq.answer: SSLC/10th standard or an equivalent examination pass. The Gun Man post additionally requires the candidate to be an ex-serviceman or have weapons training, along with a valid Arm License.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 18 to 40 years for SC/ST/Category-1, 18 to 38 years for Category-2A/2B/3A/3B, and 18 to 35 years for General category candidates, as on 27 August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is Kannada language knowledge mandatory for BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants must be able to read, write, and speak Kannada.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a written examination followed by an interview. The Second Division Clerk exam carries 200 marks, and the Peon/Gun Man exam carries 100 marks. The interview carries a maximum of 15 marks.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post in BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for only one post. If applications are submitted for more than one post, only the first submitted application is considered valid.

faq.question: Q10. Is the application fee refundable for BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, the fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances and cannot be adjusted against any other recruitment.
